Beach Bike Bungaleaux by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Beach Bike Bungaleaux is a delightful home in Seacrest and within walking distance of many distinctive eateries and shops. For fine dining, and even more shopping, Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach are just a short drive away. A convenient tram will take you to and from the beach access point, along beautiful 30A. Plus, the community pool is the second biggest in all of Florida! Inside, the open living and dining area is filled with color and wonderful décor. The spacious modern kitchen has a counter that seats three. Down the hall, a guest room has two twin beds, with a full bath, and another spacious guest room has two queens, with a full private bathroom.

A primary bedroom, king, also has its own private bathroom. Have fun exploring the area on bikes! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 844 steps (.4 mile) to beach (private access) - 100 steps (.1 mile) to the resort pool and amphitheater (seasonal concerts) - Complimentary tram service to beach and back (March-October) - 3 bedroom, 3 bath - 1,656 Sq. Ft. - Wifi - Gas grill - 3 bikes included Overnight: - King in primary bedroom; private bath; TV - 2 queens in guest room; private bath; TV - 2 twins in guest room; shared bath; TV - Pullout sofa bed in living room; shared bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
